desc:
Drive into the arena, pick a tank and fight for the Red or Blue team.

Shoot XP shapes and enemy tanks to level up. Spend your level points on damage, fire rate, range, health, speed and more. Use gems to permanently unlock new tanks and find your favourite way to fight.

There are cannons, flamethrowers, frost and poison weapons, miniguns, lasers, missiles, drones and more. 

Grab mystery boxes around the arena, find keys in chests to win new tanks, and come back each day for streak rewards.

CODES: 
FULLYLOADED - 250 GEMS
LEVELUP - 25 LEVELS
(Paste them in the settings menu)

UPDATE: 5 new tanks released, try Razor Shot, Widow, Commander, Razor Breath and Rupture in the arena!
